content.title:
Rap Direct on Instagram: "Wow… J. Cole breaks down his discography and what the end of the “J. Cole story” means 👀❄️🌎

J. Cole has teased that The Fall-Off will be his final album, but in a recent interaction with a fan he spoke more about that and what it all means to him. Cole goes on to explain that albums such as 4 Your Eyez Only, KOD, The Off-Season, and Might Delete Later were made with other intentions than telling his story. This further explains the concept of The Fall-Off and why he picks up at age 29 on the first disc, essentially continuing his life story after Forest Hills Drive. The second disc shows Cole circling back at 39 years old and updating us.

It’s exciting to hear that new music and even albums are not off the table if the right inspiration hits, he just doesn’t want to continue the story he started as the rapper coming up as “J. Cole.”

Interested to hear what y’all think of this 👀

(via J. Cole’s The Fall-Off: Trunk Sale Pt. 5 vlog)"
